baseline.baseline: metadata Q4 + RMS no_contract + cooperative Q6/attention + concurrent dispatch; original classifier
baseline.rms: All64 threads compute independently rounded squares into aligned dynamic shared storage; original8 ordered additions, tree/div/sqrt/output operations remain. Initial feature widths1..4096 and device capacity check; fallback otherwise.
baseline.q6: Lossless packed276-byte block:256 signed int8 decoded weights,16 original scale bytes,2 original half bytes,2 zero padding. Same4 interleaved integer accumulators, block scaling,8-thread cooperation/tree and quantize-once; hidden matrices only. Raw restoration required for regime3.
baseline.load: two one-minute load readings<7 at least10s apart; bounded180s; every worker before/after<7. No background-app changes.
baseline.correctness: Independent CPU words/guards and in-place/out-of-place RMS boundaries; arbitrary raw Q6 byte roundtrip including every half header, extrema and real quantization/output bits; any mismatch stops that candidate.
baseline.pilot: 3 alternating batches x16 resident repetitions on24 real RMS inputs and8 hidden-Q6 inputs; stop>5% summed GPU regression with>=75% fixture losses or>10% regression on all Tiny fixtures. Otherwise9 batches then bounded full models. Retain every observation.
baseline.full: 3 alternating fresh108-token TinyLlama pairs plus64-token Stories numerical check, same-cohort ordinary controls. Stop first pair if>10% forward or>15% worker regression. Include preprocessing/storage/setup costs.
baseline.retention: >=3% whole-history median gain,3/3 paired wins,<=2% worker regression, all load qualifications; certificates/regime/reset/bidirectional codec checks before adoption. No combined candidate.
baseline.scope: Research branch only; defaults/main unchanged, no push/release/paid resources

q6.decision: stop after kernel regression; no full-model integration

limitations: Only local Apple M3 Max and these pinned small-model histories tested.
One-minute load below7 is the declared gate; long-average loads remained elevated and waits are retained.
RMS kernel sums are not a whole-model time budget.
Q6 preprocessing/storage data is fixture-level; no measured whole-model loading or peak-RSS claim.
No certificate/regime/codec promotion campaign because neither candidate passed the speed gate.
